page-blob-unmanaged-disks-retired.title: Unmanaged disks are retired
page-blob-unmanaged-disks-retired.body: This estimate prices page blobs as VM unmanaged disks. Microsoft retired unmanaged disks on March 31, 2026 and VMs using them cannot be started, so plan managed disks instead.

citation.quote: Unmanaged disks were fully retired on March 31, 2026 (extended from previously published date of September 30, 2025).
